Recomputed exactly (2.3022%, t 2.630, 2928 days, 5854 events; pre2018 2.0345% with the benchmark rebuilt on the 80 pre2018 stocks). Definition literal and causal: g = first Close in t+1..t+20 with lnP[g]-lnO[t+1] >= ln1.10 (PLAN day numbering: day k ends at Close t+k), entry Open g+1, identical-window EW benchmark over stocks with both ends valid; lags 60 by the general rule (lags 20: t 2.96, still < 3). g and r23 hand-checked on raw-file events (TLKM 2003 g=9, ESSA 2022 g=18). Claims verified: 35.6% trigger, median day 8, 108 dropped triggers, raw +5.48% (t 4.54), fully tradable lookbacks +1.45% (t 1.75) vs non-tradable lookbacks +8.42% (t 3.27). Note: 2.30% is the mean of daily means; event-weighted per trade it is 2.07% (still above the 0.90% B cost). The all-universe P4 (+1.76%) is carried by post-2018 listings (+7.90%), pre2018 P4 is +0.09%; the "high" survivorship label is justified.

Recomputed exactly (1.8033 bps/day, t 2.048, 4599 days; pre2018 1.5315 with the pre2018 benchmark); a hand-computed benchmark for one 2022 window matches to 1e-16. Method literal (abnormal lnP[t+60]-lnP[t+20] minus the same-window EW mean of listed universe stocks, /40, x1e4; lags 40 by the general rule; lags 20 t 2.25, lags 60 t 2.00). Context verified: days 1-20 5.51 bps/day (t 3.70), days 61-120 1.58 (t 2.04), raw 6.46 (t 3.35), fully tradable 0.47 (t 0.55) vs 12.20 (t 4.25). Caveats: (1) "+0.72% abnormal per trade (40 x 1.80 bps)" uses the mean of daily means; event-weighted per trade it is 40 x 1.28 = 0.51%. (2) "Accrues mostly in the first 20 days" holds per day and within 60 days (1.10% vs 0.72%), but the abnormal drift continues at about 1.6 bps/day to day 120 (t 2.04), so the cumulative drift after day 20 (about 1.7% to day 120) exceeds the first-20-day amount. (3) As a timing rule PLAN criterion 4 needs an exposure backtest (not run; moot because |t| < 3). The test fails |t| >= 3 either way.

Recomputed exactly with an explicit per-event loop (1.7427%, t 4.755, 4557 days, 16,607 trades; pre2018 1.5730%, t 4.32; P1 3.80, P2 1.56, P3 1.22, P4 -0.16; pre2018 P4 -1.27, t -3.90). Trailing rule literal and causal (first tradable Close in bars 1..119 below min lnL of the prior 10 market days, sell at the next valid Open, else Close t+120); trailing exits hand-checked on 4 raw-file events (29, 31, 96, 51 bars). Criteria 1-3 pass and are robust to lags 120 (t 3.46), symmetric mask (1.71%, t 4.58), 10-low over own tradable bars (1.98%, t 4.98), cap at Open t+121 (1.74%), removal of the stray dates (1.76%), excluding possibly locked one-price bars (1.66%, t 4.61) and declustering (1.61%, t 3.46 with lags 120). Caveats: (1) "+1.74% raw / +0.82% abnormal per trade" are means of daily means; per trade (event-weighted) they are +1.22% / +0.45%. (2) PLAN criterion 4 for timing requires a simple exposure backtest after costs; the analyst used per-trade/per-bar arguments instead, and reason (1) (11.8 vs 12.3 bps/bar) is gross only: net of costs per bar the trailing arm is ahead (B 8.9 vs 7.8, A 10.6 vs 10.3). The verifier's indicative exposure backtest (daily equal weight over open trades, MAIN) shows no net improvement: trailing minus fixed -1.47 bps/day gross (t -1.33), -0.70 with cost A, +0.23 with cost B (t 0.21), negative in P4 (pre2018 P4 cost B -2.57 bps/day, t -1.35). So criterion 4 is not met: best class ROBUST_NOT_USABLE_ALONE if BH q <= 0.05, not usable. (3) "Regime-dependent" is informal: W2.5 passes the stability rule (3 of 4 subperiods), so PLAN's REGIME_DEPENDENT class does not apply; the reversal is nevertheless real (pre2018 P4 -1.27%, t -3.90, negative every year 2021-2025), and the all-universe P4 is propped up by post-2018 listings (+4.29%, mostly PANI and WIFI). (4) "Top 10% of trades produced 93% of the 60-day P&L" describes fixed 60-day holds of all entries, not W2.5; direct evidence: the top 10% of paired differences sum to 285% of the total, trades held >= 20 bars add +1.54 pp and early exits -0.32 pp (-0.79% each). (5) Fragile: t < 3 on liquid lookbacks with lags 120 (0.97%, t 2.69), on the abnormal basis with lags 120 (0.82%, t 2.65), and in 2008-2025 (1.02%, t 2.99 at lags 20, 2.49 at lags 120); the "high" survivorship label is justified.
